**Verdict: FAIL** on DG6 candidate `sha256:0fea8adf…4f1` (2743 files, source `031945d8761a253665c6b794e6c8d2efbacdfe65`). The reason is one new Medium finding. My open finding F-DG6-380 is now closed and verified.

**F-DG6-380 (High, mandatory): CLOSED_VERIFIED.**
- I re-ran my round-5 reproduction, widened: 4, 8 and 16 jobs of one queue failing their last attempt at the same time, 10 bursts each, 60 in total.
- Every burst kept everything: one failure-queue row, one `job.failed` event and one occurrence per failed job. There was exactly one open exception and nothing was counted twice.
- 20 concurrent API raises on one exception also kept all 21 occurrences, in 5 of 5 rounds.
- Two mutants (the fix reverted, and plain `now()` without `greatest()`) each make all 14 tests fail: the 7 in-tree tests and my 7.

**Open questions from D-216**
- **BE-Z8:** reading the stored timestamp in SQL, under the advisory lock and `FOR UPDATE`, keeps the intent of the 0101 guard. The count still steps by exactly one and the timestamp never moves backwards, so nothing is lost or double-counted.
- **BE-Z7B residuals 1–3** are acceptable:
  - the 75 operations the sweep cannot fill hold no unguarded benefit value;
  - search filters sensitive records itself, and its tests pass;
  - no adoption item can be restricted today.
- **BE-Z7B residual 4** is a defect, raised below.

**New finding: F-DG6-440 (Medium, not mandatory, owner frontend-ux-engineer, REQ-S10-002)**
- **What happens:** on the real demo stack, the TO marks benefit B01 sensitive. The TL then opens the live benefits register preview.
  - The API is correct: it gives the TL the same totals as the TO for the "Revenue uplift" section (SAR 222,750 validated, SAR 99,000 pending) and sets the restricted-records flag.
  - The screen is not: the TL sees "Includes restricted records" and "No records" ("لا توجد سجلات"), with no Total row. The TL sees 2 totals rows, the TO 3.
- **Why it matters:** ADR-0051 §2 and the user's decision D-195 Q3 say a section's totals are the same for every reader.
- **Cause:** `apps/web/src/pages/reports/ui.tsx` (`SectionView`) shows only the empty text when a table has no visible rows. The same component renders the live preview, snapshots and presentation mode.
- **Impact:** nothing leaks; the screen hides more than it should. Under D-192 a Medium must be repaired before the gate, which is why the verdict is FAIL.

**What passed on this candidate**
- **Static:** build, typecheck, lint, OpenAPI lint (932 operations), no-CDN, format and contrast all pass.
- **Unit:** passes on Node 24 and Node 22, with the locale unset and with C.UTF-8.
- **Integration:** run twice, 424/424 files and 4253 tests passed each time. The contract test confirms 932 operations, and every `p6-pending` list is empty. `tests/qa` alone: 45/45.
- **Product journeys:** 276 passed per language and locale setting.
- **Root acceptance specs:** 290 passed in both locale settings. The network capture shows only loopback connections.
- **`a22-p6-operability`:** 6/6 with the locale unset and 6/6 with C.UTF-8 (`--repeat-each=3`, both languages).
- **Demo specs and my probes:** the candidate's demo specs pass. My probes also pass: the auditor read-only pass, 360 px / 390 px / 200 % text, XSS, axe, the validation error in each language, and the Arabic export literals.
- **Reliability:** all four kill-and-restart drills pass, and the D-203 burst runs each job exactly once.
- **Load and export:** every class is within the provisional targets on this shared sandbox host. This is not Mobily production capacity.
- **Validators:** `--register DG6`, `--pipeline` and `--historical` for DG5 to DG1 all pass.

**Failures I disclosed and re-ran**
- **Node 24 unit, C.UTF-8:** one Vitest runner timeout under load. No test failed, and the re-run passes.
- **English product run, locale unset:** the browser crashed when the kernel killed processes for lack of memory. That spec passes 7/7 when run alone.
- **`exception-last-error` probe, locale-unset repeat:** 6 failures, all from my own probe. It needs a stale KPI that `a17-failing-connector-exception` creates, and I left that spec out of this run. The probe passes whenever a17 runs first.
- **Restricted-label probe:** in the first demo run, the Arabic case failed on a version-conflict bug in my probe. I fixed it, and the later runs fail only on the F-DG6-440 assertion.

**Disk:** the shared volume was nearly full, so I deleted agent transcripts and other delivery docs from my disposable clones. No test reads them.

The records are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG6/round-6/`: `qa-verifier.json`, `qa-verifier.verifications.json` and `qa-verifier.findings.json`. Evidence is under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/qa/round-6/` and my probes under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG6/qa/tests/round-6/`. All data is synthetic. I granted no business approval, and product G6 never implies DG7.
